provenance.closure_model: deterministic persistent treap keyed by segment key; each serialized node is 136 bytes (key 32 + content digest 32 + length 8 + two child hashes 64); point updates path-copy nodes
provenance.content_defined: row-boundary polynomial rolling checksum over a 64-row window of stable-key plus row-content fingerprints; min 256 KiB, 1/512 cut probability (about 0.43 MiB for this fixture), max 1 MiB; stable key of first row
provenance.counts: payload fetch/remove bytes plus closure bytes; planner payload bytes read, segment payload bytes hashed, and existing closure nodes visited; incremental row-index model charges only supplied changed-row payload hashes and path-node hashing after the explicitly uncharged fixture-key discovery scan
provenance.fixture: generated deterministically from explicit IR-like rows; no saved NXFI image was present in checkout or target/
provenance.graph_facts: one directed ring relation per entity and two source/confidence-distinct observations attached to that relation; these are serialized with their source entity so row-key locality includes relation and occurrence changes
provenance.jumbo_model_difference: SHA-256 IDs and a BLAKE2b-derived per-byte gear table stand in for Rust BLAKE3; exact jumbo cut offsets can differ
provenance.not_measured: real NXFI producer execution, network transfer, backend-store physical node encoding, OS cache, and wall-clock comparison against production
provenance.ordinal: exact 1 MiB byte windows, matching the current producer's window boundaries and ordinal key shape
row_fields: one canonical TypeReference link and two distinct source/confidence occurrences per entity in a ring
provenance.stable_key: BLAKE2b-128 of domain tag plus signed logical row id
provenance.stable_key_prefix: ordered buckets by the first byte of the stable key; 256 possible buckets
